methods.media_proxy: After removing URLs, visible text length <= 100; extended_entities contains a non-empty media array; no quoted_text, locally stored quoted_status_id post, or locally stored in_reply_to_id post. The URL proxy replaces the media condition with an HTTP URL condition.
methods.question_review: All seven v26 questions_requests rows were read from .context/u18/cohort-source.json and manually divided into brand-directed product action versus informational/rhetorical questions.
methods.sample_policy: Lexical samples were selected deterministically with ORDER BY md5(post_id) LIMIT 30 (or md5(post_id || brand_id) for pair samples) and reviewed qualitatively; no formal sample precision is claimed.
methods.unsanctioned_scope_caveat: Legacy posts_unsanctioned_flags is post-level, while advertising signals and account roles are per (post_id, brand_id). Their overlap cannot prove which attributed brand caused a flag on a multi-brand post.
methods.snapshot_precedence: A prior exploratory role/flag audit used the retired 20,322-post April-May SQLite extract. The September PostgreSQL dump is primary for all rates in this artifact; the snapshots must not be compared directly.

questions_and_ideas.interpretation: Questions and product requests are independent. The four v26 questions without an idea/request were informational or rhetorical on text review. A request to resolve a brand-specific issue still qualifies as ideas_requests.

distillation_and_allegations.interpretation: The useful distillation-allegation population is approximately 0.22% to 0.46% before a shadow classifier establishes precision. A negative-opinion filter misses 78.25% of the tight lexical screen. Generic allegation language is too noisy for a broad product label.

news_and_releases.interpretation: General third-party reporting is large enough to warrant news_reporting, while the much larger release-only set should remain separately filterable.

geopolitical_modes.interpretation: Most state-level framework candidates do not carry an existing national stance. This supports shadow-testing one Geopolitical taxonomy with reporting, framework, and nationalistic_stance modes rather than a geopolitical audience topic plus a separate Nationalism taxonomy. Lexical prevalence alone does not authorize live activation; a bounded prompt/cost/error comparison must pass.

media_dependency.short_definition: Visible text after removing URLs is at most 100 Unicode characters; no stored quote or locally stored reply parent is available.
media_dependency.interpretation: The structural 3.18% to 4.38% screens are upper bounds, while an agent-assessed exploratory sample found one apparent dependency. Keep context_missing and measure a dedicated media lane before paying to enrich every media post.

bai_repeated_promotion.interpretation: This is a material recurring spam source and current flags miss more than half of it. Add deterministic recurrence/promotion handling and default hiding, while retaining the posts as evidence.

qwen_clip_collision_burst.interpretation: The screen identifies a concentrated keyword-collision burst: 372 hits collapse to 12 normalized templates after removing clip numbers and URLs, with the top ten covering 92.2%. Handle it in relevance/spam policy rather than adding a classifier taxonomy branch.

official_staff_and_third_party_promotion.interpretation: Role-aware promotion policy and per-post-brand unsanctioned storage are justified. Current official lab promotion should be allowed by brand policy, while third-party advertising still needs CTA, referral, discount, free-access, repetition, or similar evidence before marketing_spam is applied. The legacy post-level flag remains compatibility data.

closed_beta_and_limited_access.interpretation: The actionable subset is too small to justify another label. Treat it as an opportunity only when the audience has a route to apply, request, register, or receive access, and leave dates unknown when the post supplies none.

owner_reference_prompt_quality.interpretation: Testimonial, result/evaluation, and idea/request need prompt calibration. Hands-on usage does not need a taxonomy change. These are owner-conformity diagnostics, not production accuracy estimates.

limitations: Historical classifier labels are model outputs, not human truth.
Lexical screens are prevalence bounds with false positives and false negatives; their deterministic samples were qualitative and do not establish precision.
The owner-reference and v27 figures come from consumed development cohorts and cannot be reported as production accuracy.
Several patterns are time-concentrated, so frozen-corpus prevalence is not a forward forecast.
